effects.label: Immunity
effects.description: Blocks Debuffs from being applied to the recipient.Immunity Buffs will not block Control Debuffs, and each Immunity buff will only negate a single Debuff before expiring. This buff can be stacked.

effects.label: Willpower
effects.description: Blocks Control Debuffs from being applied to the recipient.Each Willpower buff will only negate a single Debuff before expiring. This buff can be stacked.

effects.label: Invincibility
effects.description: Prevents the recipient from taking any damage, and blocks all Debuffs from being applied to the recipientThe duration of this Buff cannot be extended by other skills or effects.

bio: Riding atop a gem that twinkles with moonlight, Crestelle is an enigma, even to her fellow Eldrin. She speaks in riddles, often vexing her fellow lunar witches who just want to know about the next full moon. But if you're ever in danger within the Emerald Kingdom, look to the skies! For by the light of the moon, Crestelle will fly to your aid!
